venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 10/22 (MOD/Chef Joe + Saleh; entered by Joe; posted 5:11am 10/23).** Net $5,436 vs $5,240 target (+3.7%). Food $897; Standing Room $0. Comps not itemized in $ (birthday, anniversary, investor, DNL). 138 guests, $84.95 check avg. Steady Thursday; weather all over the place (rain on/off, chilly evening). 34 covers to start, sleepy first hour used for cleaning; filled by ~8pm with a small waitlist; room full most of the evening, died out ~11pm; smooth last call. Familiar faces and investors stopped by. Kitchen: nice work. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC

No-show revenue $30.
